02_data/data/native_download.py.reason: Rust-backed ctypes bridge for the whole download kernel (vy_cal_*, vy_dl_*, vy_sym_filename, vy_ts_*): converts naive wall-clock datetimes to the seconds the kernel expects, crosses a holiday set as one NUL-joined blob, and reads the kernel's one-line verdict documents back.
